title: Cats meet a new kitten with suspicious stares and silence
description:
Funda shared this clip with a solid life lesson: 'Some squads need time to warm up.'

Her new kitten stepped in like it was ready for cuddles and chaos, but the existing feline crew had other plans.

They stared in silence, throwing side-eyes sharper than claws.

No hissing, no fighting; just a slow-motion judgment session.

But behind every cold stare is a future cuddle buddy.

Hopefully, this little fluffball will win their hearts soon.
